layers.name: Promp
layers.text: How can I get started with motion design?

layers.name: Message 1
layers.text: A good way to start with motion design is to first learn the basics of design — color, typography, layout — and then pick up simple animation principles like timing, easing, and storytelling.

layers.name: Message 2
layers.text: Next, get hands-on with animation tools like Jitter to practice different styles of motion. Start small with logo animations, transitions, or short clips, and use these to refine your skills.

layers.name: Message 3
layers.text: Over time, build a portfolio that shows not just creativity but also how you use motion to communicate ideas clearly.
